name: RC-B10-0471/2025 – After § 23 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on renewing the EU-Africa partnership: building common priorities ahead of the Angola Summit
part_text: 23a. Notes with great concern the continuing high influx of illegal migrants from Africa to Europe, as well as the insufficient repatriation rates, which prove that the EU asylum system is not meeting the requirements of the 21st century; criticises the Commission and the Council for failing to make significant progress on combating illegal migration, even ten years since the start of a historically unprecedented wave of immigration; calls, therefore, on the Commission and the Council to make the fight against illegal migration a priority at the EU-African Union summit, to be held in Luanda, Angola on 24 and 25 November 2025;
